interface.title: Carbon Stock Intelligence — Ludhiana (Carbon Intelligence dashboard)
interface.field: Soil carbon and agricultural remote sensing / earth observation
interface.stage_of_work: Results review and dissemination: precomputed pipeline outputs are browsed, checked and exported
interface.what_it_is_for: Browsing district-wide soil organic carbon stock and crop NPP carbon flux estimated on a 250 m grid for Ludhiana, Punjab, with per-cell values and their data sources, random-forest validation diagnostics, and a filterable cell table you can export as CSV.

data.note: The page opens with the committed Ludhiana results already loaded: 71,197 cells, run dated 2026-10-08. It runs no computation of its own. On the map, only the Street basemap (OpenStreetMap) drew tiles. The Esri Satellite, Hybrid and Dark tiles never loaded, so the cells sat on a blank grey background. The cell values themselves loaded fine.

tree.general: Understand and reuse a gridded regional estimate of soil carbon stock and crop carbon flux, including how far its model and uncertainty can be trusted
tree.specific: Review the Ludhiana 250 m grid census of SOC stock and MOD17 NPP flux, its random-forest diagnostics, and export cells

features.name: Click-to-load grid map with switchable variable layers and a cell inspector
features.general: Show a gridded dataset on a map, load only the cells around where the user clicks, recolour the cells by a chosen variable with a matching legend, and show the chosen cell's values and where each value came from
features.specific: Carbon Indicators Map: click anywhere to load the 250 m cells nearby. Pick Elevation / Agri Class / NPP flux / SOC stock / Value source to recolour them, with the colour-bar range updating. The Grid Cell panel shows SOC stock, MOD17 NPP, elevation, land class, soil-data status and observed/interpolated flags for the nearest cell; clicking a loaded cell opens a popup with its values and SOC/NPP source

read the nearest cell in the Grid Cell side panel
press a layer button to recolour the cells by another variable
click a loaded cell for its popup with values and source flags
close the panel with ×

features.name: Model validation report with tabs (accuracy against baselines, interval coverage, permutation importance, full comparison table)

Feature importance: hoverable bar chart of the drop in R² when each input is shuffled. All comparisons: R²/RMSE/MAE/N for RF, gradient boosting, coordinates-only, training mean, ablations and block sizes
